summary_en: LLM-native assistants that answer, qualify, draft and act on real estate work.
summary_fr: Assistants LLM qui répondent, qualifient, rédigent et agissent sur le métier.

tools.name: AppFolio Property Manager
tools.positioning: The mid-market property management system that made cloud-native and mobile-first the default expectation.
tools.description: AppFolio is an all-in-one property management platform covering residential, commercial, student and community association portfolios: marketing and leasing, applicant screening, online payments, maintenance, full trust accounting and owner reporting, with AI features branded Realm.
tools.real_estate_use: A management company running a few thousand units uses it as the system of record for the whole operation. A vacancy is syndicated to the rental portals, an applicant is screened and signs a lease online, rent arrives by ACH, a maintenance request from the tenant app becomes a work order to a vendor, and the owner receives a statement generated from the same ledger. The differentiator in practice is that the accounting is genuinely built in, not bolted on.
features: Vacancy marketing with syndication to rental portals
Online applications, screening and lease e-signature
Online rent collection and utility billing
Maintenance work orders with vendor management and a 24/7 call answering option
Full trust accounting, owner statements and 1099 handling
Resident and owner portals with mobile apps

use_cases.job: Run leasing, rent, maintenance and owner accounting for thousands of units in one ledger
Receive an owner statement generated from the actual accounting rather than a spreadsheet

tools.name: EliseAI
tools.positioning: An AI leasing agent that answers, qualifies and books tours around the clock — measured on tours booked, not on messages sent.
tools.description: EliseAI provides conversational AI for multifamily and healthcare operators: it answers prospect enquiries by email, SMS, web chat and voice, qualifies against availability and criteria, schedules tours directly into the calendar, and follows up through the application and renewal stages.
tools.real_estate_use: Leasing enquiries arrive outside office hours and go cold within the hour. EliseAI answers immediately in the channel the prospect used, checks real availability against the property management system, and books the tour without a human. Operators measure it on tour conversion and on the leasing headcount it lets them redeploy.
features: Conversational responses across email, SMS, web chat and voice
Availability-aware qualification against the property management system
Automatic tour scheduling into leasing calendars
Application follow-up and document chasing
Renewal and delinquency outreach campaigns
Maintenance request intake and triage

use_cases.job: Answer and qualify every after-hours leasing enquiry without adding staff
Chase renewals and missing application documents automatically

tools.name: Entrata
tools.positioning: A single-stack multifamily operating system — the accounting ledger and the leasing website are the same product, not an integration.
tools.description: Entrata is a multifamily-focused platform combining property accounting, leasing and marketing websites, resident portals, utility billing, insurance, revenue management and an AI leasing agent. Its architectural claim is one database behind every module rather than a suite assembled by acquisition.
tools.real_estate_use: Large apartment operators use it to run a lease-up and a stabilised asset on the same ledger. A prospect finds the community site, is answered by the AI leasing agent at midnight, tours, applies and signs — and the rent, concessions and renewal pricing all post to the same accounting without a nightly file transfer between systems.
features: Property accounting and general ledger for multifamily
Marketing websites and ILS syndication per community
AI leasing agent handling prospect enquiries and tour scheduling
Resident portal with payments, renewals and service requests
Revenue management and pricing optimisation
Utility billing, insurance and ancillary revenue modules

use_cases.job: Operate a large apartment portfolio with leasing, pricing and accounting on one database
Compare asset performance across a portfolio without reconciling systems

capabilities: AI leasing agent for enquiries and tours

tools.name: Follow Up Boss
tools.positioning: The CRM real estate teams run their day on — every lead source lands in one inbox and the follow-up is enforced by the system.
tools.description: A sales-team CRM built specifically for residential brokerages. It ingests leads from portals, websites and ad platforms, routes them by rule to the right agent, and drives activity through action plans, calling queues and a shared team inbox. Acquired by Zillow Group in 2023 and kept as a standalone product.
tools.real_estate_use: Used by agent teams and brokerages to make sure a portal lead is contacted in minutes rather than hours. Leads arrive from Zillow, Realtor.com and the brokerage site, get assigned by round robin or by geography, and enter an automated call-text-email cadence. Managers watch speed-to-lead, conversation counts and pipeline stage rather than guessing who is actually working their database.
features: Lead routing rules with round robin, first-to-claim and geographic assignment
Action plans — multi-step automated text, email and call task sequences
Team inbox with shared call, text and email history per contact
Smart lists that resurface a database contact when they re-engage
Calling with recording, voicemail drop and dialer queues
Reporting on speed to lead, agent activity and source ROI

use_cases.job: Distribute paid portal leads across a team and prove which source converts
Work a past-client and sphere database on an automated cadence instead of ad hoc

tools.name: Genius
tools.positioning: An AI agent for French block and rental managers that answers mail, takes calls and finds the document behind the question.
tools.description: Genius is an AI assistant for syndics de copropriété and rental managers. It builds a memory per building and per lot from the material already held there, contracts, general meeting minutes, diagnostics, anonymised mail threads, works orders, then drafts answers to owner and tenant enquiries, answers the phone, and retrieves the document a question refers to. The manager validates before anything leaves. The company is based in Lyon and states it works with over 200 property administration firms.
tools.real_estate_use: A block manager holding several dozen buildings gets the same question all week, a copropriétaire asking for the last general meeting minutes, a tenant asking who to call about a leak, and each answer costs a search through years of files. Genius is aimed at that queue: it already carries the building's history, so it drafts the reply with the right attachment and the manager only presses send. The second situation is a handover, when a portfolio moves from one syndic to another or a manager leaves. What normally disappears with the person, who the caretaker is, which contractor did the roof, why the last assembly voted the way it did, stays in the building's memory and the successor picks it up in minutes rather than months.
features: Per-building and per-lot memory built from contracts, minutes and diagnostics
Drafted replies to owner and tenant mail, validated before sending
Telephone answering for routine enquiries
Document retrieval across the building's history
Rental management side covering leases, receipts and inventories

use_cases.job: Clear the daily queue of copropriétaire enquiries without searching the archive
Take over a portfolio and recover a building's history after a manager leaves

tools.name: Keyzia
tools.positioning: A French platform for deploying AI use cases across a real estate or construction company, with European hosting and a per-address data layer.
tools.description: Keyzia is a French application that lets a real estate or construction company test, deploy and centralise its AI use cases in one place rather than leaving them scattered across individual accounts. It is sold to estate agents, property administrators and syndics, tradespeople and renovators, banks and insurers, and energy actors, each with its own set of prepared uses: preparing a full listing mandate, analysing quotes and invoices, energy diagnosis, risk and green-value assessment. A module called KeyPark holds a portfolio of addresses with the history attached to each property, covering past transactions, works and diagnostics, with notifications when something changes. An interactive map layer adds address-level data for spotting projects on a territory. The vendor states data is hosted in Europe.
tools.real_estate_use: The AI problem inside a French agency or syndic is not that nobody uses it, it is that everyone uses it separately, in a personal account, with client data. Keyzia is positioned against exactly that: it puts the prepared use cases in one company tool, integrated where the teams already work, so the practice becomes shared rather than hidden. For an agent, the working moment is preparing a mandate: the property's transaction history, its diagnostics, its past works and its surroundings pulled together in minutes instead of an afternoon of portal-hopping. For a property administrator, it is watching a stock of buildings and anticipating which ones will need renovation work. European hosting is a purchase criterion in this market, not a detail.
features: Centralised catalogue of AI use cases deployable across a company
Integration into the business tools the teams already use
KeyPark address portfolio with per-property history of transactions, works and diagnostics
Change notifications on tracked properties
Interactive territory map enriched with address-level data
Quote and invoice document analysis

use_cases.job: Assemble a complete listing mandate from a property's history and surroundings in minutes
Watch a stock of buildings and anticipate which need renovation work
Assess a property's risk and energy value without ordering a study

capabilities: Prepared business use cases for real estate and construction

tools.name: Knock CRM
tools.positioning: Front-office leasing platform for multifamily: self-scheduled tours, unified prospect messaging, source attribution and team performance oversight.
tools.description: Knock CRM is a leasing customer-relationship platform for multifamily owners and operators, now published by RealPage. It groups tour scheduling, marketing attribution, prospect messaging, task management, visitor experience and team oversight into one front-office suite. Knock Now lets a prospective renter self-schedule a tour from any website or app. Messaging brings email, text, voice and chat into a single screen. Source attribution ties each lead back to the marketing channel that produced it and drives automated campaigns. Benchmarking and performance trends give leasing leadership visibility into individual and team activity. The vendor also offers AI solutions, advanced analytics and a data cloud with API access alongside the core CRM.
tools.real_estate_use: A leasing team at a large apartment community loses prospects between the first inquiry and the tour. With Knock the renter books their own slot straight from the property website, so nobody waits for a callback, and every subsequent exchange — text, email, call, chat — lands in one inbox where any agent on shift can pick it up. The regional marketer looks at source attribution to see which portal or campaign is actually filling the calendar and cuts the ones that are not. The leasing director uses the benchmarking view to compare conversion across communities and to see which agents let follow-ups lapse.
features: Self-scheduled tours from any property website or app
Unified inbox across email, text, voice and chat
Marketing source attribution and automated campaigns
Task management for follow-up on open prospects
Leasing team benchmarking and performance trends
Data cloud and API access for reporting

use_cases.job: Let prospective renters book their own tours and keep every follow-up in one shared inbox
Attribute each lead to its marketing channel and stop funding the ones that do not convert
Compare leasing conversion and team activity across communities in one benchmarking view

integrations: Partner directory published by the vendor

tools.name: Lofty
tools.positioning: An all-in-one platform where the IDX website, the ad spend and the CRM are the same product, so a click is tracked to a closing.
tools.description: Lofty bundles an IDX website, lead-generation advertising, CRM, dialer, email and SMS marketing, and transaction tracking into one subscription. Renamed from Chime in 2023. Sold mostly to teams and brokerages that want a single vendor rather than a stack.
tools.real_estate_use: A team buys traffic through Lofty's ad management, the visitor lands on a Lofty IDX site, their property searches are recorded against their CRM record, and an AI assistant opens the conversation by text. The differentiator in daily use is behavioural triggering — the agent is alerted when a contact revisits a listing or saves a search, not on a calendar timer.
features: IDX website with agent, team and brokerage templates
Behavioural lead alerts driven by on-site property search activity
AI assistant that texts and qualifies inbound leads
Built-in dialer, SMS and drip email campaigns
Facebook and Google ad management with lead attribution
Smart plans and transaction pipeline

use_cases.job: Run lead generation, nurture and site under one vendor with one attribution report
Get alerted the moment a past lead resumes searching and re-engage the same day

tools.name: Pilotim
tools.positioning: Full-web software for French estate agencies, pairing property and client management with an AI assistant built into the daily workflow.
tools.description: Pilotim is a French web-based estate agency software covering property and contact management, matching of buyers against listings, communication material, templated emails and activity history. It embeds an AI assistant, marketed as IA Pilotim, which drafts or rewrites listing copy from the property's attributes, turns an agent's notes into a visit report for the owner, writes SEO articles for the agency blog, restyles or virtually furnishes interior photos and returns before-and-after images, answers questions asked in plain language over the agency's own listings, estimates, contacts and statistics, and creates a property from dictation on mobile. The publisher also sells agency websites, paid and organic search work and training; software plans are priced publicly per month.
tools.real_estate_use: An independent French agency runs its day inside Pilotim: entering a mandate, matching it against the buyer base, publishing it, and keeping the record of what was said and when. The AI is aimed squarely at the two tasks agents postpone, writing the listing text and writing the visit report back to the owner, and the voice capture on mobile exists so a property can be created during the visit rather than back at the desk. The assistant also reads the vendor's own documentation and can open the right form or run the action it just described, which is how a new negotiator gets productive without a training session. Agencies that buy the website and search work from the same publisher get lead capture wired into the same base.
features: Property and contact management with buyer-to-listing matching
AI drafting of listing copy from the property's attributes
AI visit reports written from the agent's notes for the owner
Virtual restyling and furnishing of interior photos, delivered as before and after
Natural-language querying of the agency's listings, estimates, contacts and statistics
Voice creation of a property from the mobile application

use_cases.job: Create a property by voice during the visit and get the listing text and the owner's report written back
Run listings, buyer matching and the agency website from a single publisher

tools.name: Respage
tools.positioning: Lead generation, AI leasing and marketing operations built only for multifamily, from first search to renewal.
tools.description: Respage is a marketing and leasing platform aimed at apartment communities. It builds the property websites, runs the paid and organic acquisition around them — search, maps, social advertising, Google Business Profile — and answers the traffic that arrives with a chatbot and an AI leasing agent. A leasing CRM, review solicitation, reputation management, resident surveys and an events module sit on the same account.
tools.real_estate_use: A multifamily operator with a dozen communities usually buys a website vendor, an advertising agency, a chatbot and a reputation tool separately, then discovers that none of them share a lead. Respage is the argument for buying that chain from one place: the ad that produced the enquiry, the bot that answered it at ten at night and the CRM that carries it to a signed lease are the same system. The AI leasing piece is the part that decides the purchase for most teams — prospect volume arrives outside office hours and a leasing office of two people cannot answer it. Marketing agencies serving multifamily are the competition, not other software.
features: Community websites built and hosted
AI leasing agent and prospect chatbot
Leasing CRM for prospect follow-up
Paid search, social advertising and SEO
Review solicitation and reputation management
Resident surveys and community events module

use_cases.job: Answer prospect enquiries outside leasing office hours
Run acquisition and leasing for several communities on one platform

tools.name: Structurely
tools.positioning: An AI inside sales agent for the leads an agent will never call back — the ones two months old.
tools.description: Structurely provides AI-driven text and voice conversation for real estate and mortgage lead follow-up: it engages new and aged leads, holds a qualifying conversation over days or weeks, and hands a warm, qualified contact back to a human agent.
tools.real_estate_use: A team buying leads accumulates thousands of contacts nobody has time to nurture. The economics of an AI agent are different from a human inside sales agent: it can pursue a two-year-old lead for months at no marginal cost. The product is judged on appointments produced from a database the team had written off.
features: AI text and voice conversation for new and aged leads
Long-horizon nurture campaigns over weeks and months
Qualification against buying timeline, financing and motivation
Live handoff to a human agent when a lead is ready
CRM integration writing conversation history back
Appointment setting into agent calendars

use_cases.job: Resurrect a database of aged leads nobody has time to call
Replace or extend a human inside sales team on lead qualification

capabilities: Conversational lead qualification by SMS and voice

tools.name: Vantaca
tools.positioning: Community association management platform organised around coordinated workflows, with AI agents that carry out routine back-office work.
tools.description: Vantaca is a US platform for companies that manage homeowner and community associations. It combines a full accounting suite covering receivables, payables, budgeting and financial reporting with integrated banking and transaction matching, a business intelligence layer called Vantaca IQ for portfolio dashboards and benchmarking, and a revenue capture module for billing the services a management company performs. A set of AI agents branded HOAi runs inside the platform on resident support by email, chat, form and phone, on receivables, payables and financial reporting, and on community management work such as board packets, budgets, architectural review and violations.
tools.real_estate_use: A management company holding a portfolio of associations spends most of its day on work no one bills for: answering the same homeowner questions, chasing an invoice approval, assembling a board packet the week before a meeting. Vantaca is the system where that work is defined as a workflow rather than a habit, so a manager taking on ten more communities does not need ten more people. Its accounting side matters as much as its operations side, because association money is held per community and a discrepancy between the bank and the ledger has to surface before a board meeting, not after it. Firms come to it when their portfolio has outgrown a general property management tool that treats an association like a landlord.
features: Accounting suite covering receivables, payables, budgeting and financial reporting
Integrated banking with transaction matching against the ledger
Configurable workflows per management company process
Vantaca IQ portfolio dashboards, performance tracking and industry benchmarking
Revenue Manager for billing the management company's own services
HOAi agents for resident support, accounting and community management tasks

use_cases.job: Run a portfolio of associations on one set of defined workflows instead of per-manager habits
Close the month on association books that reconcile against the bank

capabilities: Resident support agents answering email, chat, forms and phone
Automation of receivables, payables and financial reporting
Board packet, budget and violation preparation

tools.name: Ylopo
tools.positioning: Advertising and AI follow-up bolted onto the CRM a team already uses, instead of replacing it.
tools.description: Ylopo runs paid lead generation on Google and Meta, provides branded home search sites, and layers AI text and voice follow-up on top of an existing CRM — most commonly Follow Up Boss — rather than asking a team to migrate.
tools.real_estate_use: Teams that already standardised on a CRM will not move for an ad product. Ylopo's design reflects that: it generates and nurtures, and writes everything back into the CRM of record. Its dynamic listing ads and seller-lead products are the practical draw, with AI voice follow-up handling first contact at scale.
features: Managed Google and Meta advertising for buyer and seller leads
Branded home search sites with behavioural tracking
AI text and AI voice follow-up on new and aged leads
Dynamic remarketing ads featuring listings a lead viewed
Seller lead products with valuation landing pages
Write-back into an existing CRM rather than replacing it

use_cases.job: Add paid acquisition and AI follow-up without migrating off the current CRM
Retarget past site visitors with the specific homes they looked at

capabilities: AI text and voice lead follow-up
